# ViewsMax

> ViewsMax is a social posting + link tracking/analytics SaaS for creators and
> marketers. Compose and schedule posts to YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn,
> Threads, Instagram, and Bluesky; create offers and tracked links; see which
> posts and platforms drive clicks, conversions, and revenue. User data is
> private — AI agents act on a user's behalf via an authenticated MCP server
> (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, or a per-user API key) or the REST API.

## AI & Agent Access

- [Connect your AI](https://viewsmax.com/ai.md): copy-paste setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and raw REST
- [Capability discovery (JSON)](https://api.viewsmax.com/api/ai): MCP endpoint, auth modes, full tool list, rate limits
- MCP endpoint: https://api.viewsmax.com/api/mcp (Streamable HTTP; Bearer auth — OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with dynamic client registration, or a `vmx_` API key from Settings → AI Assistant Access)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.viewsmax.com/docs.openapi) · [REST API reference](https://api.viewsmax.com/docs)
- OAuth discovery: https://api.viewsmax.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- [OpenClaw skill](https://viewsmax.com/skills/viewsmax/SKILL.md)

## Product

- [Home](https://viewsmax.com/): make content that makes sales — cross-platform posting with revenue attribution
- [About](https://viewsmax.com/about.md): how posts, offers, tracked links, and attribution fit together
- [Pricing](https://viewsmax.com/pricing.md): free to start; Starter $29, Creator $59, Pro $99, Agency $149 per month

# Connect your AI to ViewsMax

ViewsMax exposes an MCP server and a REST API so AI assistants and agents can
post to a user's connected social accounts (YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn,
Threads, Instagram, Bluesky), manage offers and tracked links, and read
click/conversion/revenue analytics — on the user's behalf, with their
permission. User data is private; all access is authenticated.

- **MCP endpoint:** `https://api.viewsmax.com/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP)
- **Capability discovery (JSON):** `https://api.viewsmax.com/api/ai`
- **REST API:** `https://api.viewsmax.com/api` — [OpenAPI spec](https://api.viewsmax.com/docs.openapi) · [API reference](https://api.viewsmax.com/docs)

## Credentials

Two options, both sent as a Bearer token:

1. **OAuth (recommended for chat apps).** Point an MCP client at the endpoint
   above; the user signs in and approves in the browser (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE,
   dynamic client registration supported). The consent screen offers
   read-only or full access. No key handling.
2. **API key (for headless agents and scripts).** In the ViewsMax app:
   **Settings → AI Assistant Access → generate key** (`vmx_...`). Choose
   read-only or full access. The key is shown once; rotating it invalidates
   the old one. The same key works on the REST API (posts, offers, tracking,
   stats — read-only keys are limited to GET).

## Claude (claude.ai / Claude Desktop)

Settings → Connectors → **Add custom connector** → URL
`https://api.viewsmax.com/api/mcp` → complete the sign-in approval.

## Claude Code

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http viewsmax https://api.viewsmax.com/api/mcp
```

or in `.mcp.json`:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "viewsmax": { "type": "http", "url": "https://api.viewsmax.com/api/mcp" } } }
```

OAuth prompts on first use. For headless use add
`"headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer vmx_YOUR_KEY" }`.

## ChatGPT

Settings → Apps & Connectors → enable **Developer mode** → add a connector
with the MCP URL above and complete OAuth. ViewsMax is an *action* connector
(create/schedule posts, read stats) — use it from regular chats with
connectors enabled; it is not a deep-research search/fetch source.

## Cursor

`.cursor/mcp.json`:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "viewsmax": {
  "url": "https://api.viewsmax.com/api/mcp",
  "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer vmx_YOUR_KEY" } } } }
```

## OpenClaw

Install the ViewsMax skill (SKILL.md drives the REST API):
download it from <https://viewsmax.com/skills/viewsmax/SKILL.md> into your
agent's skills directory, then set `VIEWSMAX_API_KEY` in the agent's
environment (full-access key). Alternatively point OpenClaw's MCP support at
the MCP endpoint above.

## Hermes Agent

Add to your MCP servers config:

```json
{ "viewsmax": { "transport": "http",
  "url": "https://api.viewsmax.com/api/mcp",
  "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer vmx_YOUR_KEY" } } }
```

## Plain REST / curl

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer vmx_YOUR_KEY" https://api.viewsmax.com/api/posts
```

Responses use a `{ success, message, data }` envelope. Full reference:
<https://api.viewsmax.com/docs>.

## What agents can do (18 MCP tools)

`list_connected_accounts`, `upload_media`, `create_post`, `list_posts`,
`get_post`, `update_post`, `delete_post`, `list_offers`, `create_offer`,
`get_offer`, `update_offer`, `delete_offer`, `create_tracking_link`,
`get_offer_stats`, `get_stats_timeseries`, `disconnect_account`,
`get_connect_url`, `create_feature_request`.

Typical posting flow: `list_connected_accounts` → `upload_media` (TikTok /
Instagram / YouTube need a video or image) → `create_post` (status `draft`,
`posted`, or `scheduled` + `scheduled_at`) → publishing is asynchronous, so
poll `get_post` for per-platform results.

`create_post`/`update_post` accept an `options` object keyed by platform for
per-platform publish settings — e.g. `options.tiktok.privacy_level` and
`options.tiktok.auto_add_music` (boolean, default `false`) which lets TikTok
auto-add its recommended music to a photo slideshow (ignored for video; there
is no music option for Instagram).

Typical analytics flow: `list_offers` → `get_offer_stats` /
`get_stats_timeseries` (clicks + conversions bucketed by hour or day).

## Security & limits

- Read-only credentials cannot write, anywhere.
- Every AI tool call is recorded in the user's audit log (Settings → AI
  Assistant Access → activity).
- Rate limits: 120 MCP requests/min per token; 180 `create_post`/hour;
  40 `upload_media`/hour. HTTP 429 = back off.
- Rotate the API key any time to revoke access instantly.

# About ViewsMax

ViewsMax (https://viewsmax.com) is a social posting + sales tracking SaaS for
creators and marketers: make content that makes sales.

## What it does

- **Post everywhere from one place.** Compose once, publish or schedule to
  YouTube, TikTok, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Threads, Instagram, and Bluesky.
  Drafts, a content calendar, and automatic retries per platform.
- **Track what sells.** Create an *offer* (a product or campaign you promote),
  generate *tracked links* for it, and place them in videos, posts, emails, or
  bios. ViewsMax records clicks, conversions, and revenue per link.
- **Attribution, not vanity metrics.** See which platform, which post, and
  which time of day actually drives sales — funnels, customer journeys,
  first-touch vs last-touch comparison, time-to-convert, and a
  revenue-per-view leaderboard.
- **AI-agent ready.** An MCP server and REST API let AI assistants (Claude,
  ChatGPT, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, …) post and read analytics on a user's
  behalf. See [Connect your AI](https://viewsmax.com/ai.md).

## Core concepts

| Concept | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Post | One piece of content fanned out to one or more platforms; each platform target reports its own publish status. |
| Offer | A product/campaign being promoted, with an offer URL and conversion value. |
| Tracked link | A short link tied to an offer; records clicks and attributes conversions. |
| Conversion | A sale or goal completion attributed back to the link/post that drove it. |

## Who it's for

Creators, solo marketers, and agencies who publish on several platforms and
want to know which content generates revenue — not just views.

# ViewsMax Pricing

Free to start (no card required). Paid plans are monthly, in USD.
Sign up at https://viewsmax.com/auth — plan checkout at https://viewsmax.com/checkout.

| Plan | Price | Channels | Offers | Posts / month |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | — | — | — (content review & topic tools) |
| Starter | $29/mo | 5 | 1 | 400 |
| Creator (most popular) | $59/mo | 30 | 5 | Unlimited |
| Pro | $99/mo | Unlimited | 10 | Unlimited |
| Agency | $149/mo | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |

- **Starter** — "Launch your first offer." For creators just getting started.
- **Creator** — "For brands that sell." Growing creators running multiple offers.
- **Pro** — "Scale every channel." Professionals scaling their reach.
- **Agency** — "For teams & agencies." Unlimited everything.

All paid plans include cross-platform posting/scheduling (YouTube, TikTok, X,
LinkedIn, Threads, Instagram, Bluesky), tracked links with click/conversion/
revenue attribution, analytics dashboards, and AI agent access (MCP + API
key — see https://viewsmax.com/ai.md).

Limits are enforced per account; current values are always available from the
authenticated API (`GET /api/plans`).
